title: test(xdr): add a malformed XDR corpus
problem: Malformed-input coverage is limited to a few inline strings.
why: A shared corpus prevents regressions in error handling for hostile input.
context: Golden fixtures cover valid values; malformed inputs are separate.
scope: Add truncated, over-long, and structurally invalid XDR samples
Assert structured errors and no panics
guidance: Keep samples small and name them descriptively.
acceptance: Every sample is handled without panic
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(rpc): add snapshot tests for RPC response models
problem: RPC model parsing is asserted piecewise.
why: Snapshots catch unintended shape changes in models.
context: Mock transport tests cover parsing behavior.
scope: Store golden JSON for each modeled response and compare on parse/serialize
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test: add cross-platform and endianness tests
problem: Path and byte-order behavior is only tested incidentally.
why: CI runs three OSes; explicit tests keep behavior consistent across them.
context: XDR is big-endian; path handling differs on Windows.
scope: Add tests for path normalization and byte-order-sensitive encoding
Assert identical output across platforms
guidance: Use explicit byte sequences in assertions.
acceptance: Tests pass on all CI OSes
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test: add a regression corpus runner
problem: Fixtures are exercised ad hoc rather than by a single runner.
why: A runner makes adding regression cases a data-only change.
context: The fixture loader is a separate issue.
scope: Add a runner that discovers fixtures and asserts expected outcomes
Fail with a clear diff on mismatch
guidance: Keep the expected-outcome format simple and documented.
acceptance: New fixtures are picked up without code changes
tests: Runner tests including an intentional mismatch
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(contracts): add fixture WASM contracts
problem: Contract inspection has no committed WASM fixtures.
why: Real fixtures are required to test spec extraction and safety checks.
context: Contract inspection is a separate issue.
scope: Add a small, clearly licensed WASM fixture built from a documented source contract
Record provenance and checksum
guidance: Prefer a minimal contract and commit the source alongside the artifact.
acceptance: Inspection tests run against the fixture
security: Fixture must be benign and contain no secrets.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(ci): add a scheduled fuzz smoke job
problem: Fuzz targets exist but are not exercised automatically.
why: A bounded scheduled run catches regressions without slowing normal CI.
scope: Add a scheduled workflow running each fuzz target for a bounded time
Fail on a crash artifact
guidance: Keep runs short and pinned to a stable nightly.

title: feat(cli): add configuration profiles
problem: There is no way to keep multiple named configurations (for example local and CI).
why: Profiles make switching networks and endpoints ergonomic.
context: The configuration system is a separate issue.
scope: Support named profiles selected by flag or environment
Define precedence clearly
guidance: Document precedence and validate unknown profiles.
acceptance: Profiles resolve deterministically and are tested
security: Profiles must not embed secrets; document this.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(cli): unify global flags across commands
problem: Flags such as output format, network, and verbosity are inconsistent across commands.
why: Consistent flags reduce cognitive load and documentation drift.
scope: Make format, network, and quiet/verbose global and consistent
Document the full flag set
guidance: Keep backward compatibility for existing flags.
acceptance: Global flags behave identically across commands
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(cli): improve error presentation with suggestions
problem: Errors are terse and do not suggest a fix.
scope: Add short, actionable suggestions for common errors
Never print secrets or full URLs with userinfo
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(cli): add verbosity control
problem: There is no way to increase or decrease diagnostic output.
why: Verbosity control helps debugging without changing results.
scope: Add `--verbose` and `--quiet` affecting stderr only
guidance: Never change stdout content based on verbosity.
tests: CLI tests asserting stdout is unchanged
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(cli): add a JSON error output mode
problem: Errors are only human-readable, so CI cannot parse them.
why: Machine-readable errors help automation distinguish failure classes.
context: The output envelope is a separate issue.
scope: When `--format json`, emit errors as structured objects with a category
Keep exit codes unchanged
acceptance: JSON errors include category and message
tests: CLI tests for a usage and a decode error
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(cli): add stdin input for decode commands
problem: Decode commands accept only arguments, so pipelines are awkward.
why: Stdin support enables shell pipelines and editor integration.
context: Batch file input is a separate issue.
scope: Accept `-` to read a single value from stdin
Bound the amount read
guidance: Require an explicit `-` marker; never block when stdin is a terminal.
acceptance: Stdin input works and is bounded
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.
